Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for nonconference basketball competitions between the Gonzaga University Bulldogs and the University of Washington Huskies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to intercollegiate sports; adding a new section tochapter 28B.20 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that maintaining ahealthy collegiate sports rivalry is a necessary component in fosteringschool spirit and institutional pride. The legislature further findsthat no rivalry in college sports history is as exciting andcompetitive as the battles between our state's two premier basketballteams, the Gonzaga University Bulldogs and the University of WashingtonHuskies.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Beginning with the 201415 academic year, the intercollegiatebasketball teams of the University of Washington and Gonzaga Universitymust compete against each other in a nonconference, regular seasonbasketball game.
